clockFooter: Real time is the default. Demo time runs the story clock, and the buttons move it forward (from real time, they start the demo clock at today). Countdowns, cooling periods and due dates follow the clock in use.
coolingFooter: Optional, for demos, and only for you. Off by default. Turning the waits on needs nothing; turning them off again needs your passkey. Both are written to your ledger. Real deployments always wait.
coolingHint: On: a new recipient can be paid 24 h after it is added, and loosened rules apply after 24 h. Off: both apply at once.
demoTimeHint: Off: the app uses today's real date and time. On: it uses the demo clock.
dueAuto: Paid inside your mandate, no prompt: {{names}}.
dueFooter: Runs Kassa's scheduler now for your own account, at today's date: bills due within 3 days are proposed. A bill inside a mandate you signed (your rent) is paid without a prompt; anything else waits for your passkey. Simulated money.
homeFooter: Simulated: your family sends money to your own Kassa wallet (about EUR 2,000 in your home currency). Kassa gets the bank's signed notice; nothing is paid until you approve.
homeLimit: Parents already sent money 3 times today in the demo. Try again tomorrow.
intro: Simulated data only. Use these tools to walk through the app quickly.
notifFooter: Sends the text as a bank or wallet notification. Simulated, nothing is charged.
replayHint: Replays the agent's recorded answers instead of asking the live model.
resetConfirm: Reset all simulated data? This cannot be undone.
